subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should interactive parity land as one sponsored core rollout after blockers are fixed, or should this branch be split into staged PRs around questions, plan mode, and goal mode?
rationale: The feature direction fits the roadmap, but the branch changes public SDK surface, defaults, UI/channel behavior, and goal/plan runtime policy in one large PR, so automation cannot choose the rollout boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Split into staged PRs
options.body: Require the branch to land in smaller question, plan, and goal slices after the SDK leak, accidental approval path, and live channel proof are fixed.

options.title: Sponsor one broad merge
options.body: Allow one large merge only after the concrete blockers are fixed and maintainers accept the expanded review, rollout, and upgrade burden.

options.title: Pause core rollout
options.body: Keep the roadmap issue open but defer this core implementation until maintainers decide which pieces belong in core versus plugin or later work.

recommendation.title: Split into staged PRs
recommendation.body: Require the branch to land in smaller question, plan, and goal slices after the SDK leak, accidental approval path, and live channel proof are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is adjacent ownership of update_plan and strict-agentic behavior that this PR changes.
